title: Particles
description: Particle effects cinematography fills the air with countable bits: dust, sparks, pollen, a weather of motes, each one catching light. Atmosphere you can inventory, not a blanket of fog.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: A shaft becomes a census. Embers drift.
Flour hangs. Use it when the air should be a substance the eye can number, and when a beam is the reason we see it.
It is the wrong tool when the air should vanish, or when you only need a shaft of scatter with no specks. If the bits are soap films with refraction, you want bubbles.
If the picture is only the beam, you want volumetric light. If the bits are only dust in a church, dust motes may be enough.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Backlight the bits. Place a hard source so each mote has a specular tick.
Name the species: dust, embers, pollen, ash. Keep the subject readable through the cloud.
Volume is a shaft, not a filter over the whole frame. The camera can be locked.
The motes move. Prompt particles around the subject: dust, sparks, pollen, a weather of bits, light catching each one.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it for holy rooms, barns, battle aftercare, a kitchen with flour. Do not use it when the air should be invisible.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is Fog or a mist overlay. The tell is a blanket with no individual specks.
The fix is backlight, a named species, and motes you could count.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is particles in film?
Particles make weather out of bits: dust, sparks, pollen, each catching light. The air is countable, not a fog blanket.
Particles vs volumetric light
Volumetric light is the beam. Particles are the bits that make the beam visible and that can exist as sparks or pollen even outside a single shaft. One is the volume. The other is the inventory.
When should I use particles?
Use it when the air should be a substance you can number. Skip it when the air should disappear, or when you only need a clean shaft.
How do I prompt particles for AI image or video?
Write Particles around [Subject], dust, sparks, pollen, light catching each one. Name the species and a backlight. Demand discrete motes, not a mist filter.
